author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Kingdoms mostly benefit you by letting you hit kingdom raids. As a very early player, this probably isn't your priority, but by T4/T5 you can absolutely start making raid progress. Kingdoms mostly work when they're very active - the benefits fall drastically as kingdom activity does, so look for a large group that actually kicks inactive members.

There are a few 'obligations' for players, but its just quick in-game stuff. Kingdom gauntlets just give you a monster or two to kill of your own tier, and wars are PvP against someone your tier. Most kingdoms dont have more than one a day of these until you join a group that's really active and well managed.

If you dont want to deal with this, you can largely ignore kingdoms. You'll just struggle to progress in the endgame since Kingdom raids are one of the only reliable sources for certain crafting materials needed to progress, but you have a while until that is on your radar.
